steps: Authored a config-driven 'defend the Core' siege: builds its own Core objective + ring of breach gates, no external template
Per wave: FORTIFY intermission -> BREACH (spawn escalating raiders from gate ring) -> wait until all cleared
Each raider is a self-contained Humanoid rig with march-to-core AI + touch damage; clearance driven by Humanoid.Died
VICTORY printed once the final wave clears; all phases tagged [Siege]

recipe.text: Distinct concept in the RoundLoop family: a Breach Siege defending a central Core, with a fortify intermission and enemies pouring from a ring of breach gates rather than a plain survival ring. Fully data-driven from a CONFIG table (gate count/radius, fortify time, per-wave count/health/damage). Self-contained: constructs Core, gates, and raider enemies with no external EnemyTemplate. Wave clearance is player-level combat via Humanoid.Died decrementing a live counter — no auto-kill/test hook. Every lifecycle event prints with a [Siege] tag for VERIFY.
